description: A dataset to predict the age of abalone shells based on physical measurements, often used in ecological studies.

variables.meaning: The column 'Sex' contains data of type categorical. It represents the Sex of the observation.
The column 'Length' contains data of type numerical. It represents the Length of the observation.
The column 'Diameter' contains data of type numerical. It represents the Diameter of the observation.
The column 'Height' contains data of type numerical. It represents the Height of the observation.
The column 'Whole weight' contains data of type numerical. It represents the Whole weight of the observation.
The column 'Shucked weight' contains data of type numerical. It represents the Shucked weight of the observation.
The column 'Viscera weight' contains data of type numerical. It represents the Viscera weight of the observation.
The column 'Shell weight' contains data of type numerical. It represents the Shell weight of the observation.
The column 'Rings' contains data of type numerical. It represents the Rings of the observation.
